objectives: Know that alcohol-based hand rub is flammable and must be stored safely.

sources.use: CDC hand hygiene page: definition and fire-safety points

stem: Why must alcohol-based hand rub be stored with care?

options.text: Because alcohol-based hand rub contains flammable alcohol and can release ignitable vapour.
options.feedback: Use approved storage and dispenser locations away from ignition risks, follow local fire-safety rules and allow the rub to dry fully before proceeding with care.

options.text: Because it goes off quickly in the heat.
options.feedback: The risk named is fire, not spoilage.

options.text: Because it makes the floor slippery.
